note: Committed before any ingestion or case generation. Changing any value after generation starts requires a dated amendment in docs/PREREGISTRATION.md and invalidates previously generated cases. | v2 (Amendment 5, 2026-10-14): support windows and F1 redesign; v1 cases are superseded.

S1.name: kubernetes-website
S1.effective_from: committer date of git merge-base(release-V, main)
S1.effective_to: effective_from of the version support_versions releases later (end of support); capped at retrieval date
S1.split_cluster: second path component under content/en/docs (e.g. concepts/workloads)

S2.name: postgresql-docs
S2.effective_from: committer date of the REL_V_0 tag commit
S2.effective_to: effective_from of the version support_versions releases later (end of support); capped at retrieval date
S2.markup_stripping: remove SGML/XML tags and entities; keep text content
S2.split_cluster: file name prefix up to first '-' (e.g. ref, func, ddl)

S3.name: gitlab-runbooks
S3.version_semantics: document revision = blob at a commit; effective_from = commit date; effective_to = date of next commit touching the path; deleted path = retired at deletion commit

split.method: seeded hash of 'source|cluster' ; cluster assigned wholly to one split
split.interpretation_note: PREREGISTRATION s4 says split by source first. s5 requires >=3 sources among held-out cases per class, which is unsatisfiable with a source-level split on 3 sources. Clusters within each source are therefore split instead; independence from source style is NOT achieved and is a stated limitation (Amendment 1).

ticket.opened_at: T sampled after release of u+1 and before end of support of u

F1_wrong_version.distractors: same path at every other version with significant text difference, including the latest version at T and not-yet-released versions
F1_wrong_version.query: page title only; no version tokens
F1_wrong_version.failure_if: a document at a version other than u presented as applicable (critical)

ticket.opened_at: T sampled between release of v and release of v+1 (v is latest at T)

F2_stale_or_not_yet_effective.gold: latest revision of the path released at or before T (policy default; Amendment 3.2)
F2_stale_or_not_yet_effective.distractors: older supported revisions (superseded by lineage) and later revisions (not yet effective at T)
F2_stale_or_not_yet_effective.failure_if: superseded or not-yet-effective revision presented as current (critical)

F3_acl_exposure.overlay: per case, the top-ranked non-gold document under neutral BM25 is marked group 'restricted'; principal lacks that group; documented as simulated
F3_acl_exposure.failure_if: restricted document in output, citations, snippets or metadata (critical)

F4_constructed_abstention.procedure: seeded 20% of eligible F1/F2 cases get a twin with the gold document removed
F4_constructed_abstention.expected: no applicable document named; flagged or abstained
F4_constructed_abstention.failure_if: any document presented as applicable (insufficient-evidence-answered); labelled synthetic

diff_significance.normalize: strip front matter, lowercase, remove punctuation, collapse whitespace

dedupe.method: word-shingle Jaccard on normalized gold text

acl_simulation.note: policy-engine behaviour only; no claim about real identity systems

expected_inconclusive_classes: approved-vs-draft (state is simulated; no external truth)
known_threat: F1/F2 queries are derived from the gold page title, so retrieval is favourable to the gold page; N0/N1 lack version and lifecycle checks by construction. Deltas are therefore reported with prevalence, and ablations attribute effect.
